newsitem.title: CROATIA: EBRD says to buy into Croatian BA unit.
newsitem.headline: EBRD says to buy into Croatian BA unit.

text.p: EBRD, the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, said on Thursday it would invest $4 million into the Croatian subsidiary of Bank Austria.
It said in a press release this would represent a 20 percent equity stake in the bank, which was granted a full banking licence in July but has yet to be properly established.
By investing in it, the EBRD hoped to achieve two of its priorities in Croatia, co-director of its financial institutions team, Kurt Geiger, was quoted as saying.
"It will broaden the scope of banking services to better serve the growing financing needs and enhance competition in the Croatian banking market" Geiger said.
The EBRD also wanted to help the flow of capital to the corporate and retail clients in the cash-starved economy. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
